description: This file defines the grpc logging package 'grpclog' for gRPC in Go, including logging functions for different severity levels and environment-based configuration.

methods.name: V
methods.description: Reports whether verbosity level l is at least the requested verbose level.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Logs to the INFO log.

methods.name: Infof
methods.description: Logs to the INFO log with formatted arguments.

methods.name: Infoln
methods.description: Logs to the INFO log with arguments handled like fmt.Println.

methods.name: Warning
methods.description: Logs to the WARNING log.

methods.name: Warningf
methods.description: Logs to the WARNING log with formatted arguments.

methods.name: Warningln
methods.description: Logs to the WARNING log with arguments handled like fmt.Println.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs to the ERROR log.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Logs to the ERROR log with formatted arguments.

methods.name: Errorln
methods.description: Logs to the ERROR log with arguments handled like fmt.Println.

methods.name: Fatal
methods.description: Logs to the FATAL log and exits with code 1.

methods.name: Fatalf
methods.description: Logs to the FATAL log with formatted arguments and exits.

methods.name: Fatalln
methods.description: Logs to the FATAL log with arguments and exits.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Deprecated: use Info.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Deprecated: use Infof.

methods.name: Println
methods.description: Deprecated: use Infoln.

methods.name: InfoDepth
methods.description: Logs to the INFO log at a specified depth; experimental API.

methods.name: WarningDepth
methods.description: Logs to the WARNING log at a specified depth; experimental API.

methods.name: ErrorDepth
methods.description: Logs to the ERROR log at a specified depth; experimental API.

methods.name: FatalDepth
methods.description: Logs to the FATAL log at a specified depth; experimental API.
